correctness.rationale: The local alternating Schur-complement slice at restriction rank 2t is submersive because V/L -> K_t* is onto. This identifies the rank-2s orbit normal space with wedge^2(K*) and its trace-dual conormal with wedge^2(K), with ranks preserved by the full-rank outside maps. Exact Pfaffian rank strata have codimension binomial(d-2j,2); the first even defect is the degree-d/2 Pfaffian hypersurface, and the odd defect is codimension three with degree d(d^2-1)/24 from the genuine Buchsbaum-Eisenbud height-three resolution. Smoothness, irreducibility and boundary qualifications follow from symplectic orbit normal slices. An independent symbolic Hilbert-numerator computation checked degrees d=5,7,9,11, but that finite computation is not the geometric proof.
